items.title: Complete post-beta compliance readiness: counsel review, roles, transfers and payment self-assessment
items.outcome: The readiness work that is not launch blocking but is required before public release is completed: counsel review of the advice boundary and consent design, a named privacy owner, a cross-border transfer position per processor, the payment self-assessment and a maintained processing record.
items.context: The compliance floor covers what a beta user makes mandatory. This ticket carries what a public launch and a real payment flow make mandatory, so neither set is diluted by being merged into one late epic.
scope: Counsel review of the advice boundary across application copy, store listing and model output
Named privacy owner with a defined review cadence and a watch item for significant-entity criteria
Cross-border transfer position documented for every processor including model providers
Payment self-assessment appropriate to a hosted payment page arrangement
Records of processing and a data-flow map from device through the backend to any processor
Verification sweep of every unverified claim that feeds a critical decision
acceptance_criteria: Counsel review is completed and recorded, with any required copy changes ticketed
Every processor has a documented transfer position and a signed agreement
The self-assessment confirms no card data reaches our systems and the traffic evidence supports it
The data-flow map matches the captured traffic evidence and is updated per release
Each previously unverified claim is either re-verified with a date and source or marked as an assumption with a fallback
A named owner exists for every ongoing obligation rather than the epic owning it collectively
contracts_schema: Processing record published in a machine-readable form so it can be diffed per release
security_privacy: The record states which data leaves the country and under what basis
No claim is published that the traffic evidence does not support
observability: Review completion dates and the next review date tracked and visible
tests: Reconciliation of the data-flow map against captured traffic
Copy scan against the reviewed advice-boundary wording
rollout_rollback: Gated before public release; the beta proceeds on the compliance floor alone
non_goals: Launch-blocking obligations, which belong to the compliance floor epic
Account aggregator positioning, which is its own epic
items.parallel_boundary: Primary repo docs. Owns the reviews and records. Copy changes land in the repository that renders them.
definition_of_done: Document merged and dated, with the option chosen and the options rejected recorded
Linked from every epic and ticket it unblocks
Reviewed through a current-head core-reviewer attestation from a separate qualified reviewer-agent session
Follow-up implementation tickets created or updated to reference it
Declared dependencies mirrored as native GitHub blockedBy edges
